metadata.architect_diagnosis: Inventory gate passed. Python-only boundary: normalize/sort unique nonzero keyframes, deterministic shoot naming, compute driver positions across 0..10, and generate per-shape weight states. Maya animation queries, duplication/grouping, blendShape/proxy attrs/connections and driven-key writes remain host-backed. Zero shapes must be rejected before segment division. metadata.architect_diagnosis: RopeRoll inventory boundary accepted. Normalize non-empty object/destination lists and require equal cardinality. Legacy effective=driver+offset; activeCount=N-effective; denominator=activeCount+1; each item i is active when activeCount>=i, with start=(activeCount-(i-1))/denominator, end=i/denominator, destination=1-active. Maya point/orient constraints and DG wiring remain host-backed. Reject states where denominator is zero rather than creating divide-by-zero DG behavior; validate offset/range explicitly.
